source: 101 Victor players in 101 post-hotfix Phantom+ replays (2026-11-05..07), pair fights after his first Pain Battery hit (sim/scripts/mechanics/battery_timing.py --raw)
note: per phase: holds = equal-probability seconds from a fight's start to his first Pain Battery hit (Kaplan-Meier, null = not by 20 s); cdr = the real Victors' mean item cooldown reduction in those fights (the sim scales a drawn time by (1 + cdr) / (1 + the build's cdr))
